policies.name: case_events_select_editor
policies.using:
(is_editor() AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM practice_cases pc
  WHERE ((pc.id = case_events.case_id) AND (is_admin() OR (pc.workflow_status <> 'archived'::case_workflow_status))))))

policies.name: case_reviews_select_participants
policies.using: (is_admin() OR (is_reviewer() AND ((assigned_to = auth.uid()) OR (assigned_to IS NULL))) OR (requested_by = auth.uid()) OR (assigned_to = auth.uid()))

policies.name: case_versions_select_editor
policies.using:
(is_editor() AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM practice_cases pc
  WHERE ((pc.id = case_versions.case_id) AND (is_admin() OR (pc.workflow_status <> 'archived'::case_workflow_status))))))

policies.name: practice_cases_insert_editor
policies.check: (is_editor() AND (workflow_status = 'draft'::case_workflow_status) AND (publication_tier = 'internal'::case_publication_tier) AND ((created_by IS NULL) OR (created_by = auth.uid())))

policies.name: wf_step_read
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM workflow_templates t
  WHERE ((t.id = workflow_steps.template_id) AND ((t.workflow_status = 'published'::workflow_template_status) OR is_editor()))))

policies.name: wf_event_read
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM workflow_execution_sessions s
  WHERE ((s.id = workflow_events.session_id) AND ((s.user_id = auth.uid()) OR is_admin()))))
